commands.name: kungfu agent brief
commands.purpose: Print the local onboarding brief.

commands.name: kungfu agent docs
commands.purpose: Show where the installed agent pack lives and list its documents.

commands.name: kungfu agent capabilities --json
commands.purpose: Print the machine-readable pack index, command catalog, and KFD-3 registry summary.

commands.name: kungfu agent choose-mode --json
commands.purpose: Choose brief, report, atlas-projection, trace, managed-run, or remote-sync from explicit flags.

commands.name: kungfu agent install-skill --target codex
commands.purpose: Preview or explicitly copy a provider skill file.

commands.name: kungfu agent install-skill --target claude
commands.purpose: Preview or explicitly copy a provider skill file.

commands.name: kungfu agent status --target codex --json
commands.purpose: Show local bootstrap mode, report closeout gate, and policy path.

commands.name: kungfu agent bootstrap --target codex --mode report
commands.purpose: Preview or apply a provider bootstrap policy and optional skill install.

commands.name: kungfu agent mode set --target codex --mode managed-run
commands.purpose: Switch a provider between report, managed-run, trace, brief, or remote-sync policy modes.

commands.name: kungfu agent unbootstrap --target codex
commands.purpose: Disable bootstrap policy without deleting receipts, work items, or copied skills.

commands.name: kungfu agent uninstall --target codex
commands.purpose: Show complete uninstall steps; dry-run by default and no data deletion.

commands.name: kungfu agent verify --json
commands.purpose: Verify the installed agent-first KFD-3 collaboration-interface closure.

commands.name: kungfu trace -- <command>
commands.purpose: Capture an existing command into a local Rewind trace.

commands.name: kungfu managed-run --provider <provider> --prompt <task>
commands.purpose: Run a provider CLI under Kungfu supervision, skill context, and cost/audit capture.

commands.name: kungfu work create <title> --json
commands.purpose: Create structured work facts in the local journal.

commands.name: kungfu report run begin --work <work-id> --provider <provider> --json
commands.purpose: Open a reported external agent run without changing how the agent is launched.

commands.name: kungfu report cost --run <run-id> --provider <provider> --json
commands.purpose: Append reported token and cost facts to a run journal.

commands.name: kungfu report run end --run <run-id> --status <status> --json
commands.purpose: Close a reported external run and refresh its manifest.

commands.name: kungfu codex report-goal --goal-id <goal-id> --status <status> --json
commands.purpose: Report a native Codex goal into Kungfu work/Rewind facts and emit a receipt.

commands.name: kungfu codex verify-goal-report --receipt <path> --json
commands.purpose: Verify a Codex goal report receipt before closeout.

commands.name: kungfu atlas import --repo <atlas-repo> --json
commands.purpose: Snapshot an Atlas-style control-plane repo into Kungfu's local read-only projection.

commands.name: kungfu atlas assess-mission <mission-id> --json
commands.purpose: Query admitted Mission/Go facts and persist a purpose-bound progress TrustReport.

commands.name: kungfu atlas create-go <mission-id> <goal-id> --title <title> --objective <objective> --actor <actor> --json
commands.purpose: Create a Kungfu-native Go linked to an admitted Mission without writing back to the bridged source.

commands.name: kungfu atlas claim-completion <mission-id> <goal-id> --statement <statement> --actor <actor> --evidence-episode <id> --json
commands.purpose: Record an explicit completion claim with independently verifiable Episode evidence.

commands.name: kungfu atlas assess-completion <mission-id> <goal-id> --json
commands.purpose: Assess a Go completion claim for a declared purpose and fail closed on missing evidence.

commands.name: kungfu atlas show import --json
commands.purpose: Show the latest Atlas projection batch metadata and source repo head.

commands.name: kungfu atlas show missions --json
commands.purpose: List imported Atlas mission cards from the latest projection.

commands.name: kungfu atlas show goals --json
commands.purpose: List imported Atlas goal cards from the latest projection.

commands.name: kungfu atlas show markers --json
commands.purpose: List imported Atlas worktree-status markers from the latest projection.

commands.name: kungfu storage status --scope all --json
commands.purpose: Inspect source manifests, accepted cursors, sync roots, and storage projection status.

commands.name: kungfu storage fsck --scope all --json
commands.purpose: Verify generic storage manifests, payload hashes, source registry drift, and orphan payload candidates.

commands.name: kungfu storage repair --scope episode --episode-id <id> --plan --dry-run --json
commands.purpose: Convert degraded storage and Episode fsck diagnostics into machine-readable repair candidates without mutating facts.

commands.name: kungfu storage repair --scope episode --episode-id <id> --fetch --out repair-material.json --dry-run --json
commands.purpose: Collect local repair material from the runtime and registered remote mirrors into a JSON artifact without applying it.

commands.name: kungfu storage repair --scope episode --episode-id <id> --apply --from <bundle.json> --dry-run --json
commands.purpose: Validate local repair material and preview Episode manifest or payload restoration; use --execute only for explicit writes.

commands.name: kungfu storage rebuild-index --scope all --dry-run --json
commands.purpose: Preview or rebuild the derived source registry from accepted latest manifests.

commands.name: kungfu storage gc --scope all --dry-run --json
commands.purpose: Plan unreachable payload garbage collection without deleting payloads.

commands.name: kungfu storage compact --scope all --dry-run --json
commands.purpose: Plan fact-ledger compaction without archiving, deleting, vacuuming, or rewriting facts.

commands.name: kungfu storage verify-sync --source <source-id> --json
commands.purpose: Simulate manifest-backed local export/import/fsck and compare sync roots.

commands.name: kungfu storage query --table entries --scope source --source <source-id> --json
commands.purpose: Query C++-owned SQLite storage projection rows without reading SQLite directly from bindings.

commands.name: kungfu query capabilities --json
commands.purpose: Discover the versioned fact-query contract, logical operators, formats, limits, and stable error codes.

commands.name: kungfu query schema --json
commands.purpose: Print the supported versioned QueryDefinition JSON schema.

commands.name: kungfu query describe episodes --json
commands.purpose: Describe the Episode authority source, canonical order, cuts, and result fields.

commands.name: kungfu query examples --json
commands.purpose: Print runnable head and exact historical-cut QueryDefinition examples.

commands.name: kungfu query validate --file query.json --json
commands.purpose: Validate and canonically hash a QueryDefinition without executing it.

commands.name: kungfu query explain --file query.json --json
commands.purpose: Show the normalized LogicalPlan and bounded authority-scan cost shape without claiming proof.

commands.name: kungfu query prove --file query.json --json
commands.purpose: Execute the shared LogicalPlan through the authority-scan oracle and return rows with proof lineage.

commands.name: kungfu query prove --episode-id <id> --json
commands.purpose: Execute the same planner through the semantic Episode shortcut.

commands.name: kungfu query changelog --file query.json --json
commands.purpose: Read a bounded resumable page of the typed proof-carrying changelog.

commands.name: kungfu query saved-view --file saved-view.json --json
commands.purpose: Inspect the same QueryDefinition and presentation-only ViewSpec artifact used by the GUI.

commands.name: kungfu query saved list --json
commands.purpose: Discover the workspace-local journal-backed saved query catalog shared with the GUI.

commands.name: kungfu query saved import --file saved-view.json --json
commands.purpose: Create a durable workspace saved query from the portable saved-view artifact.

commands.name: kungfu query saved show <id> --json
commands.purpose: Inspect the current definition, view, revision, and content hash for one saved query.

commands.name: kungfu query saved update <id> --expected-revision <n> --file saved-view.json --json
commands.purpose: Append an optimistic-concurrency-checked saved query revision.

commands.name: kungfu query saved run <id> --json
commands.purpose: Run the current saved query revision and bind its id, revision, and content hash to the proof result.

commands.name: kungfu query saved export <id>
commands.purpose: Export portable kungfu.query.saved-view/v1 JSON without copying raw workspace storage.

commands.name: kungfu query saved history <id> --json
commands.purpose: Inspect the complete create, update, and delete revision history.

commands.name: kungfu query saved delete <id> --expected-revision <n> --json
commands.purpose: Append a tombstone revision without erasing prior saved query facts.

commands.name: kungfu query saved rebuild --json
commands.purpose: Rebuild and verify the current catalog projection from authoritative journal events.

commands.name: kungfu facts capabilities
commands.purpose: Discover the libkungfu-owned declaration, admission, time, and journal contract for user or domain facts.

commands.name: kungfu facts declare-world --file world.json --system-time <ns>
commands.purpose: Journal an effective-time contract-world declaration and bind it to a sealed Episode.

commands.name: kungfu facts declare-surface --file surface.json --system-time <ns>
commands.purpose: Journal one FlatBuffers-owned fact-surface declaration under an exact contract-world root.

commands.name: kungfu facts observe --file observation.json --system-time <ns>
commands.purpose: Record an observation plus its replayable admitted, rejected, ambiguous, or unverifiable outcome.

commands.name: kungfu facts state --cut-system-time <ns> --subject-key <key>
commands.purpose: Fold admitted facts at head or a historical declaration cut while preserving correction, retraction, and source conflict history.

commands.name: kungfu facts library
commands.purpose: Discover the supported managed Fact Library profile, content stores, portability modes, and known limits.

commands.name: kungfu facts type create --id <id> --version <version> --source <source> --schema-file <schema.json>
commands.purpose: Create or idempotently recover an exact versioned fact type with an owned content-addressed JSON schema.

commands.name: kungfu facts type list
commands.purpose: List reusable fact types and their exact declaration, schema, authority, Episode, and proof coordinates in the selected data root.

commands.name: kungfu facts material put --type <id> --type-version <version> --source <source> --subject <key> --payload-file <payload.json>
commands.purpose: Store JSON material and append its admitted observation through one intent-level operation.

commands.name: kungfu facts material list --type <id> --subject <key>
commands.purpose: Read current and historical fact material with hydrated content-addressed payloads.

commands.name: kungfu facts export --out <bundle.json> [--thin]
commands.purpose: Export the selected Fact Library as a full self-contained or explicitly thin Episode bundle.

commands.name: kungfu facts import --file <bundle.json> [--execute]
commands.purpose: Verify a Fact Library bundle by default and append it only with explicit execute intent.

commands.name: kungfu remote add <source-id> --host <host> --home <kf-home> --json
commands.purpose: Register a source runtime for source-scoped evidence sync.

commands.name: kungfu remote sync <source-id> --json
commands.purpose: Mirror source runtime facts under remotes/<source-id>/runtime without mixing them into local truth.

commands.name: kungfu skill catalog --json
commands.purpose: Print the compact agent-visible Kungfu Skill catalog.

commands.name: kungfu skill read <key-or-path> --json
commands.purpose: Load a full SKILL.md on demand with audit evidence.

commands.name: kungfu kfx install <source>
commands.purpose: Install a kfx package through the trust disclosure path.

brief.when: Read local facts before choosing a runtime action.

report.next: kungfu work create <title> --json; for native Codex goals prefer kungfu codex report-goal --goal-id <goal-id> --status <status> --json.
report.when: The useful output is structured work state, decisions, checkpoints, artifacts, or reported external run facts.

atlas-projection.next: kungfu atlas import --repo <atlas-repo> --json; kungfu storage fsck --scope all --json; kungfu storage verify-sync --source <source-id> --json; kungfu atlas show missions --json; kungfu atlas assess-mission <mission-id> --json
atlas-projection.when: The user asks to sync, import, inspect, or visualize an Atlas-style mission/goal/worktree control-plane repo inside Kungfu.

trace.when: An existing command or agent run should be captured without rewriting it.

managed-run.when: Kungfu should launch the provider CLI and bind skill context, run evidence, and reported cost.

remote-sync.next: kungfu remote add <source-id> --host <host> --home <kf-home> --json; kungfu remote sync <source-id> --json
remote-sync.when: The main problem is moving evidence across machines or runtime trust boundaries.
